description.value:
Requires Attunement by a character with renown in the Ashen Verdict.

This metal band bears a stylized helm, its nose guard and crest made of purple gems. The forge mark of Ormus the Penitent, a stylized O, is stamped inside it.

While wearing this ring, you gain the following benefits (Ashen Verdict renown required in parentheses).

Might (Uncommon, Renown 3+). You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls of melee weapon attacks.

Greater Might (Rare, Renown 10+). Your Strength score is also 19, unless it is already 19 or higher.

Unmatched Might (Very Rare, Renown 25+). Your Strength score is 21 instead, unless it is already 21 or higher, and you can treat any 1 you roll on a damage die of a melee weapon as a 2.

Endless Might (Legendary, Renown 50+). Your Strength score is 25 instead, unless it is already 25 or higher.
